translations.web: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.
translations.bsb: Like a bird that strays from its nest is a man who wanders from his home.
translations.kjv: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.
translations.asv: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, So is a man that wandereth from his place.
